title: Chapter 16: Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India

blocks.content: The Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India is one of the most important constitutional authorities responsible for auditing the accounts of the Union and State governments. Known as the 'Guardian of the Public Purse,' the CAG ensures financial accountability and transparency in the use of public funds.

items: The term 'Guardian of the Public Purse' specifically refers to the CAG in constitutional law questions.
CAG's jurisdiction covers auditing accounts of BOTH the Union and State governments, which is a frequent trick question in exams.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India is a key constitutional authority.
The CAG is responsible for auditing the accounts of both Union and State governments.
The position is famously known as the 'Guardian of the Public Purse'.
The primary mandate of the CAG is to ensure financial accountability and transparency in public spending.
